questions.source_text: Which dynasty of Delhi Sultanate ruled for the shortest period? (A) Khilji (B) Tughlaq (C) Sayyid (D) Lodi Ans: (A) Solution: The Delhi Sultanate was an Islamic empire based in Delhi that stretched over large parts of the Indian subcontinent for 320 years (1206–1526). Five dynasties ruled over the Delhi Sultanate sequentially: the Mamluk dynasty (1206–1290), the Khalji dynasty (1290–1320), the Tughlaq dynasty (1320–1414), the Sayyid dynasty (1414–1451), and the Lodi dynasty (1451–1526). The shortest period was of Khilji.
